Highlights of the composition of our director nominees:
✓   Average director nominee tenure of approximately five years
✓   Highly experienced group of Board nominees with 83% of the director nominees joining the Board after the 2019 annual meeting
✓   11 of 12 director nominees, and all committee members, are independent
✓   Executive sessions of independent directors held after every regular Board meeting
✓   Robust succession planning process for senior leadership positions, including in-depth meetings between individual directors and senior executives other than the CEO
✓   Regular visits to Boeing production sites by each director
✓   Comprehensive annual evaluations of the Board, each of the committees, and individual directors, led by the independent Board Chair and Governance & Public Policy Committee Chair
✓   Limits on director service on outside boards
✓   Directors retainer stock units are not distributed as shares of Boeing common stock until after termination of Board service
✓   Codes of conduct for all employees and directors
✓   Proxy access right for shareholders seeking to nominate directors
✓   Multiple means for shareholders to communicate directly with the independent Board Chair, the nonemployee directors as a group, or the Audit Committee
✓   Majority voting for all directors in an uncontested election and resignation policy for any director who fails to receive a majority vote
